title: Klaro · local-first Mac care
description: Native macOS utility that turns cleanup, storage checks and system reports into a calm review flow. One scan, one plan, decision always on the user's side.
problem: Mac cleanup apps delete silently, use scare tactics, and give no audit trail. Users either ignore the problem or hand control to a black box.
system: SwiftUI dashboard with local scan engine, CLI for audit and duplicate detection, safe cleanup preview that moves files to Trash (never silent delete), and HTML report export with JSON-LD and LLM-readable metadata.
artifact: Working MVP: macOS app bundle, CLI binary, HTML report with structured metadata. 7 Swift tests passing.
outcome: Private prototype. The app already scans, previews cleanup candidates, executes safe moves to Trash, and exports structured reports without sending anything off-device.
